Dr. Amara Okafor — Soft Skin Mechanics said about it: The GelSight: High-Resolution Robot Tactile Sensors for Estimating Geometry and Force (E2) shows a clear silicone elastomer with Shore A values between 5 and 20 and neo-Hookean coefficient mu of 0.145 megapascal (MPa) in a domed sheet under 2.5 millimetre (mm) thick, and the SynTouch - BioTac (E3) shows a rigid core surrounded by an elastic liquid-filled skin giving human-fingertip compliance, so I propose a molded 20 mm diameter by 22 mm long silicone dome with 1.5 mm skin over gel on a rigid core as drawn in the fingertip section sketch (E15), using purchasable silicones of the Dragon Skin 30 vs.
